//: Compatibility policy for OTA bundles. Changing these values is a deliberate release decision, not a per-release override.
//minNativeVersion: Oldest Android versionName still supported. Bundles declare nv<this>. 1.0.0 APKs shipped without the OTA public key and cannot verify a signed bundle, so they are deliberately outside the supported set; they reject new bundles cleanly as native_incompatible. Raise this only when dropping older APKs; it must never be newer than android versionName.
//schemaVersion: Informational mirror of src/features/exam/offline/schemaVersion.ts. The build fails if the two disagree; the module stays authoritative because the client bundles it.
